verdict.rationale: Mastra is a TypeScript framework that can deploy a Mastra server, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question. However, the evidence pack documents no OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found 404s on every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path. llms.txt, docs.md, embedded docs and the MCP docs server are documentation aids, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
